 State Announces 2026 Public Holiday Schedule
 Private Sector Labour Relations has information on festive season public holiday arrangements for state system employers and employees, including key WA award provisions for Boxing Day 2026.
 WA's public holiday legislation, the Public and Bank Holidays Act 1972, provides that when Boxing Day falls on a Saturday, the next following Monday is also a public holiday. This means that for the 2026 Festive season, the public holidays are:
 Christmas Day - Friday 25 December 2026
 Boxing Day - Saturday 26 and Monday 28 December 2026
 New Years Day - Friday 1 January 2027
 Importantly, for state system employees, when a public holiday falls on a weekend, public holiday entitlements will vary depending on whether the employee is award free, or the provisions of their specific WA Award.
 Boxing Day 2026 WA award public holiday entitlements outlines public holiday arrangements for Boxing Day for state system employees, including key WA award provisions.
 Over the festive season, the Wageline contact centre will be closed from 4.30 pm on Tuesday 22 December 2026 and will reopen on Monday 4 January 2027.
